transport.serial: USB serial console, one command per line

tools.name: lynn_play_action
tools.description: Make Lynn, the pixel-art mascot on the device's Lynn page, perform an animated action. Interactions play once and return to idle; idle activities loop a few times. Optionally set the line shown in her speech card. read: Lynn reads a book, turning pages and smiling at a passage.; type: Lynn types on her laptop, glances up, and hits Enter with a flourish.; tea: Lynn sips tea and lets out a contented sigh.; music: Lynn listens to music on headphones, bobbing her head to the beat.; stretch: Lynn stretches her arms up, yawns, and relaxes.; doze: Lynn dozes off standing up, nodding, then wakes with a start.; water: Lynn waters a potted plant until it blooms, then wipes her brow.; sweep: Lynn sweeps the floor with a small broom.; paper_plane: Lynn throws a paper airplane and watches it fly away.; doodle: Lynn doodles in a sketchbook and proudly shows a cat drawing.; pat: A hand pats Lynn on the head; she sways happily, then jumps for joy.; wave: Lynn waves hello.; cheer: Lynn cheers and hops twice with her arms up.; party: Lynn pops a party popper and confetti falls.; inspect: Lynn inspects something closely with a magnifying glass.; surprised: Lynn is startled and jumps.; confused: Lynn is confused, tilting her head and scratching it.; think: Lynn thinks it over, reviewing a sheet of paper, then nods with a check mark.; sleep: Lynn falls asleep standing up.; shy: Lynn gets shy, covering her blushing cheeks and swaying.; pout: Lynn pouts with crossed arms and stomps her foot.; cry: Lynn cries, rubbing her eyes and wailing.; laugh: Lynn laughs so hard she holds her belly.; bow: Lynn bows politely.; heart: Lynn makes a big heart with her arms, then a small heart with her hands.; thumbs_up: Lynn gives a confident thumbs up, then two.; peace: Lynn throws a playful peace sign, then a double peace.; salute: Lynn salutes smartly.; clap: Lynn claps her hands.; shrug: Lynn shrugs with her palms up.; facepalm: Lynn facepalms with a sigh.; nod: Lynn nods in agreement.; shake_head: Lynn shakes her head no.; point: Lynn points right at the viewer.; spin: Lynn spins around once.; dance: Lynn dances, swinging her arms and kicking her legs.; scared: Lynn is scared and trembles, hugging herself.; sneeze: Lynn sneezes.; snack: Lynn eats a rice ball with delight.; wink: Lynn winks with a finger to her lips.; sigh: Lynn slumps and lets out a tired sigh.

line.description: Optional Chinese or English line for her speech card (≤ 30 characters).

tools.name: lynn_say
tools.description: Change the line in Lynn's speech card without changing her animation.

tools.name: lynn_status
tools.description: Report the action Lynn is currently playing and her line.
